class CalciteActionBar(Component):
    tag = "calcite-action-bar"

        summary=None,
        props=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="actions-end-group-label",
                kind="string",
                choices=(),

                description="Specifies an accessible name for the last `calcite-action-group`.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="actions-start-group-label",
                kind="string",
                choices=(),

                description="Specifies an accessible name for the first `calcite-action-group`.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="expand-disabled",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, the expand-toggling behavior is disabled.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="expanded",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, expands the component and its contents.\nWhen a child `calcite-action` specifies `textEnabled` as `true`, its `text` initially displays adjacent to its `icon` regardless of expansion.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="expand-position",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("start", "end"),
                default="end",
                description="Specifies the position of the expand `calcite-action`.",

            ),

                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, disables automatically overflowing `calcite-action`s that won't fit into menus.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="overlay-positioning",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("fixed", "absolute"),
                default="absolute",
                description='Specifies the type of positioning to use for overlaid content, where:\n\n`"absolute"` works for most cases - positioning the component inside of overflowing parent containers, which affects the container\'s layout, and\n\n`"fixed"` is used to escape an overflowing parent container, or when the reference element\'s `position` CSS property is `"fixed"`.',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="position",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("start", "end"),
                default=None,
                description='When `expandDisabled` is `false`, specifies the expand toggle\'s chevron direction, where:\n\n`"start"` positions the expand toggle\'s chevron away from the start of the component when `expanded` is `false`, and\n`"end"` positions the expand toggle\'s chevron away from the end of the component when `expanded` is `false`.\n\nWhen `expanded` is `true`, the chevron direction is reversed.',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="scale", kind="enum", choices=("s", "m", "l"), default="m", description="Specifies the size of the expand `calcite-action`."
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="selection-appearance",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("neutral", "highlight"),
                default="neutral",
                description="Specifies the selection appearance of the component",
            ),
        ),
        fields=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="messageOverrides",
                kind="json",
                choices=(),
                type_text="Record<string, unknown> | undefined",
                default=None,
                description="Overrides individual strings used by the component.",
            ),
        ),
        events=("calciteActionBarCollapse", "calciteActionBarExpand", "calciteActionBarToggle"),
        slots=("", "actions-end", "actions-start", "expand-tooltip"),

class CalciteAlert(Component):
    """Alerts are meant to provide a way to communicate urgent or important information to users, frequently as a result of an action they took in your app. Alerts are positioned at the bottom of the page. Multiple opened alerts will be added to a queue, allowing users to dismiss them in the order they are provided."""

    tag = "calcite-alert"
    schema = ComponentSchema(
        tag="calcite-alert",
        class_name="CalciteAlert",
        summary="Alerts are meant to provide a way to communicate urgent or important information to users, frequently as a result of an action they took in your app. Alerts are positioned\nat the bottom of the page. Multiple opened alerts will be added to a queue, allowing users to dismiss them in the order they are provided.",
        props=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="auto-close",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, the component closes automatically. Recommended for passive, non-blocking alerts.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="auto-close-duration",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("medium", "fast", "slow"),
                default="medium",
                description="Specifies the duration before the component automatically closes - only use with `autoClose`.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="icon",
                kind="json",
                choices=(),
                type_text="string | boolean",
                default=None,
                description="When `true`, shows a default recommended icon. Alternatively,\npass a Calcite UI Icon name to display a specific icon.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="icon-flip-rtl",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description='When `true`, the icon will be flipped when the element direction is right-to-left (`"rtl"`).',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="kind",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("brand", "danger", "info", "warning", "success"),
                default="brand",
                description="Specifies the kind of the component, which will apply to top border and icon.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="label", kind="string", choices=(), default=None, description="Specifies an accessible label for the component."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="numbering-system",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("arab", "arabext", "latn"),
                default=None,
                description="Specifies the Unicode numeral system used by the component for localization.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="open", kind="boolean", choices=(), default="false", description="When `true`, displays and positions the component."
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="placement",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("top", "bottom", "top-start", "top-end", "bottom-start", "bottom-end"),
                default="bottom",
                description="Specifies the placement of the component.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="queue",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("last", "next", "immediate"),
                default="last",
                description="Specifies the ordering priority of the component when opened.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="scale", kind="enum", choices=("s", "m", "l"), default="m", description="Specifies the size of the component."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="top-layer-disabled",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true` and the component is `open`, disables top layer placement.\n\nOnly set this if you need complex z-index control or if top layer placement causes conflicts with third-party components.",
            ),
        ),
        fields=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="messageOverrides",
                kind="json",
                choices=(),
                type_text="Record<string, unknown> | undefined",
                default=None,
                description="Overrides individual strings used by the component.",
            ),
        ),
        events=("calciteAlertBeforeClose", "calciteAlertBeforeOpen", "calciteAlertClose", "calciteAlertOpen"),
        slots=("title", "message", "link", "actions-end"),
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        *children: Child,
        key: str | None = None,

        icon: Any = None,

        kind: Literal["brand", "danger", "info", "warning", "success"] | None = None,
        label: str | None = None,
        numbering_system: Literal["arab", "arabext", "latn"] | None = None,
        open: bool | None = None,
        placement: Literal["top", "bottom", "top-start", "top-end", "bottom-start", "bottom-end"] | None = None,

class CalciteList(Component):

                choices=("nested", "flat"),
                default="flat",
                description='Specifies the nesting behavior of `calcite-list-item`s, where\n\n`"flat"` displays `calcite-list-item`s in a uniform list, and\n\n`"nested"` displays `calcite-list-item`s under their parent element.\n\n The parent component\'s behavior should follow throughout its child elements.',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="drag-enabled",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, `calcite-list-item`s are sortable via a draggable button.",

            PropertySchema(
                name="filter-enabled",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description="When `true`, an input appears at the top of the component that can be used by end users to filter `calcite-list-item`s.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="filter-label", kind="string", choices=(), default=None, description="Specifies an accessible name for the filter input field."
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="filter-placeholder",
                kind="string",
                choices=(),
                default=None,
                description="Specifies placeholder text for the component's filter input field.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="filter-text", kind="string", choices=(), default="", description="Text for the component's filter input field."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="group",
                kind="string",
                choices=(),
                default=None,
                description="The component's group identifier.\n\nTo drag elements from one list into another, both lists must have the same group value.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="interaction-mode",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("interactive", "static"),
                default="interactive",
                description='Specifies the interaction mode of the component, where\n\n`"interactive"` allows interaction styling and pointer changes on hover,\n\n`"static"` does not allow interaction styling and pointer changes on hover -\n\nthe `"static"` value should only be used when `selectionMode` is `"none"`.',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="label",
                kind="string",
                choices=(),
                default=None,
                description="Specifies an accessible label for the component.\n\nWhen `dragEnabled` is `true` and multiple list sorting is enabled with `group`, specifies the component's name for dragging between lists.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="loading", kind="boolean", choices=(), default="false", description="When `true`, a busy indicator is displayed."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="numbering-system",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("arab", "arabext", "latn"),
                default=None,
                description="Specifies the Unicode numeral system used by the component for localization.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="scale", kind="enum", choices=("s", "m", "l"), default="m", description="Specifies the size of the component."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="selection-appearance",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("icon", "border", "highlight"),
                default="icon",
                description='Specifies the selection appearance, where\n\n`"icon"` displays a checkmark or dot,\n\n`"border"` [Deprecated] - Use `"highlight"` instead - displays a border, or\n\n`"highlight"` displays background highlight.',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="selection-mode",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("none", "single", "single-persist", "multiple"),
                default="none",
                description='Specifies the selection mode of the component, where:\n\n`"multiple"` allows any number of selections,\n\n`"single"` allows only one selection,\n\n`"single-persist"` allows one selection and prevents de-selection, and\n\n`"none"` does not allow any selections.',

class CalciteNotice(Component):
    """Notices are intended to be used to present users with important-but-not-crucial contextual tips or copy. Because notices are displayed inline, a common use case is displaying them on page-load to present users with short hints or contextual copy. They are optionally closable - useful for keeping track of whether or not a user has closed the notice. You can also choose not to display a notice on page load and set the "active" attribute as needed to contextually provide inline messaging to users."""

    tag = "calcite-notice"
    schema = ComponentSchema(
        tag="calcite-notice",
        class_name="CalciteNotice",
        summary='Notices are intended to be used to present users with important-but-not-crucial contextual tips or copy. Because\nnotices are displayed inline, a common use case is displaying them on page-load to present users with short hints or contextual copy.\nThey are optionally closable - useful for keeping track of whether or not a user has closed the notice. You can also choose not\nto display a notice on page load and set the "active" attribute as needed to contextually provide inline messaging to users.',
        props=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="appearance",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("outline-fill", "transparent"),
                default="outline-fill",
                description="Specifies the appearance of the component.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="closable", kind="boolean", choices=(), default="false", description="When `true`, displays a close button in the component."
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="icon",
                kind="json",
                choices=(),
                type_text="string | boolean",
                default=None,
                description="When `true`, shows a default recommended icon. Alternatively, pass a Calcite UI Icon name to display a specific icon.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="icon-flip-rtl",
                kind="boolean",
                choices=(),
                default="false",
                description='When `true`, the icon will be flipped when the element direction is right-to-left (`"rtl"`).',
            ),
            PropertySchema(
                name="kind",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("brand", "danger", "info", "neutral", "warning", "success"),
                default="brand",
                description="Specifies the kind of the component, which will apply to the top border and icon.",
            ),
            PropertySchema(name="open", kind="boolean", choices=(), default="false", description="When `true`, the component is visible."),
            PropertySchema(name="scale", kind="enum", choices=("s", "m", "l"), default="m", description="Specifies the size of the component."),
            PropertySchema(
                name="width",
                kind="enum",
                choices=("auto", "half", "full"),
                default="auto",
                description='Specifies the width of the component. [Deprecated] The `"half"` value is deprecated, use `"full"` instead.',
            ),
        ),
        fields=(
            PropertySchema(
                name="messageOverrides",
                kind="json",
                choices=(),
                type_text="Record<string, unknown> | undefined",
                default=None,
                description="Overrides individual strings used by the component.",
            ),
        ),
        events=("calciteNoticeBeforeClose", "calciteNoticeBeforeOpen", "calciteNoticeClose", "calciteNoticeOpen"),
        slots=("title", "message", "link", "actions-end"),
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        *children: Child,
        key: str | None = None,
        appearance: Literal["outline-fill", "transparent"] | None = None,
        closable: bool | None = None,
        icon: Any = None,
        icon_flip_rtl: bool | None = None,
        kind: Literal["brand", "danger", "info", "neutral", "warning", "success"] | None = None,
        open: bool | None = None,
        scale: Literal["s", "m", "l"] | None = None,
        width: Literal["auto", "half", "full"] | None = None,
        **props: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            *children,
            key=key,
            props={
                "appearance": appearance,
                "closable": closable,
                "icon": icon,
                "icon-flip-rtl": icon_flip_rtl,
                "kind": kind,
                "open": open,
                "scale": scale,
                "width": width,
            },

        )
